items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamla, 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me do Italian technician mare gaye aur do log ghayal hue; Kuwait aur Italy ne Iran ko zimmedar bataya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Iran-Kuwait tanav, Hormuz sankat — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ibiza ke paas tanker palta, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Spain ke Ibiza ke paas diesel bhara Malta-flag tanker Med Emre palat gaya; 17 crew me se 1 ki maut hui, 6 ghayal; abhi tel risaav nahi mila, Spain ne pradushan-roktham yojana shuru ki.

items.headline: Colombia supermarket bandhak sankat khatm, sab surakshit
items.detail: Cartagena ke supermarket me 16 ghante ke bandhak sankat ke baad suraksha balon ne sabhi bandhakon ko surakshit chhudaya; ek hamlaawar mara gaya aur baaki giraftar hue.

items.headline: Zelensky ki chetavni: Russia bada hamla karega
items.detail: Ukraine ke rashtrapati Zelensky ne kaha Russia aane wale dinon me bada hamla karne ki taiyari kar raha hai; unhone logo se missile chetavni par dhyan dene ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: ECB ke naye pramukh bane De Cos
items.detail: Eurozone deshon ne Spain ke Pablo Hernandez de Cos ko European Central Bank ka agla pramukh chuna; woh February me Christine Lagarde ki jagah lenge aur pehle Spanish ECB pramukh honge.
items.exam_angle: ECB, eurozone, kendriya bank — arthvyavastha

items.headline: Trump ne Putin se hamle rokne ko kaha
items.detail: America ke rashtrapati Trump ne kaha unhone China me Putin se Europe bhar me sainya hamle rokne ko kaha, taaki Russia-Ukraine samjhota jald ho sake; unhone yuddh ko 'complete bloodbath' bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Trump-Putin vartalap — UPSC IR

items.headline: Ramaphosa ko court se badi rahat mili
items.detail: South Africa ki Western Cape High Court ne 2022 ki Phala Phala panel report ko gair-kanuni batakar radd kar diya; isse Ramaphosa ke khilaf mahabhiyog jaanch khatm ho gayi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, Phala Phala, mahabhiyog — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kim ne tactical parmanu hathiyar badhane ko kaha
items.detail: North Korea ke neta Kim Jong Un ne parmanu samagri utpadan badhane aur tactical parmanu hathiyaron ko kai kshetron me tainat karne ko kaha; unhone desh ki parmanu sthiti ko aparivartaniya bataya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea, parmanu hathiyar, KCNA — UPSC IR

items.headline: Har ghante 5 mahilayein apno se mari
items.detail: UN ki 2026 Femicide Brief ke mutabik 2025 me duniya bhar me lagbhag 47,000 mahilayein aur ladkiyan saathi ya parivar ke haathon mari gayin — har ghante lagbhag paanch; kul 78,000 me se 60% maamle ghar ke andar hue.
items.exam_angle: UN Women, UNODC, femicide — UPSC samaj

items.headline: America me toofan, 7 lakh ghar andhere me
items.detail: Thanksgiving par America ke purvi hisse me toofan se 7.24 lakh se zyada gharon ki bijli chali gayi aur lagbhag 400 udanein radd hui; New York ki Macy's parade 100 saal me pehli baar sthagit hui. (Updated: bijli aur udaan ke aankde badhe)

items.headline: North Korea ne Russia ko hathiyar dena roka
items.detail: Ukraine ki khufia agency GUR ke mutabik Kim Jong Un ne Russia ko KN-23 missile aur golabarud dena roka, aur Russian sainya vimanon ke liye apna hawai kshetra band kar diya.
items.exam_angle: North Korea-Russia sainya sahyog, Ukraine yuddh

items.headline: Nvidia ne 4 deshon ko server bhejna roka
items.detail: America ke naye export control ke baad Nvidia ne Dell aur Supermicro se kaha Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand aur Indonesia ko AI server na bhejein, taaki China ko chip na mile.
items.exam_angle: America ke AI chip export control aur China ko chip se rokna

items.headline: 3.5 arab password aur record khule me mile
items.detail: Do asurakshit database se 3.5 arab se zyada username, password aur vyaktigat record mile — ek me lagbhag 2 arab login credential, dusre me 84 crore se zyada Chinese ID number.
items.exam_angle: Cybersecurity: data leak, infostealer malware

items.headline: Netanyahu Case 4000: judge ne hatane ko kaha
items.detail: Israel ki adalat ne Netanyahu ke bhrashtachar mukadme ke sabse gambhir Case 4000 ko hatane ka sujhav diya, kaha dosh siddh hone ki sambhavna kam hai; Attorney General vichar karengi.

items.headline: New Zealand me sarkar ka bahumat khatm
items.detail: Antim chunav parinamo me PM Christopher Luxon ki gathbandhan sarkar 130 seaton wali sansad me 65 seat par atak gayi, ab Opportunity Party ke samarthan ke bina sarkar nahi banegi.
items.exam_angle: New Zealand chunav parinam aur gathbandhan sarkar

items.headline: Gaza me hamle, Hamas neta samet 10 mare
items.detail: Guruvaar ko Israel ke hamlo me Gaza me kam se kam 10 log mare, jinme Hamas ke varishth neta Khaled Abu Nada bhi shaamil the; Hamas ne jawab dene ki chetavni di hai.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Palestine sangharsh aur Gaza yuddh-viram

items.headline: Argentina ne note chhapna band kiya
items.detail: Argentina ki Congress ne 141-0 se kanoon pass kar kendriya bank ko sarkar ke kharch ke liye note chhapne se rok diya; bank ka kaam ab sirf peso ki keemat bachana hoga.
items.exam_angle: Argentina ki arthvyavastha aur kendriya bank ki swatantrata

items.headline: Trump ka janm-nagrikta aadesh phir ruka
items.detail: America ke dusre judge ne bhi Trump ke janm ke aadhar par nagrikta simit karne wale aadesh par rok laga di; ab dono faislon ko palte bina ye aadesh lagu nahi ho sakta.
items.exam_angle: America me janm-nagrikta aur nyaypalika ki bhoomika

items.headline: Ukraine ke laser ne Russian drone giraya
items.detail: Ukraine ka daava hai ki uske Blysk laser hathiyar ne pehli baar ladai me Russia ka jet-powered Geran drone giraya; ye pranali ek mahatvapurna sthal ki raksha kar rahi thi.
items.exam_angle: Laser raksha pranali aur drone yuddh

items.headline: Abrego Garcia America se Spain pahunche
items.detail: Galat tareeke se El Salvador bhej diye gaye Kilmar Abrego Garcia ne America se khud Spain jaane ka faisla kiya aur budhvaar subah Madrid pahunche; unhone kaha is baar ve aazadi ke saath ja rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: America ki immigration neeti aur nirvasan vivad

items.headline: Prince William ke ghar me chori, 2 giraftar
items.detail: Sandringham estate par Prince William aur Princess Catherine ke Anmer Hall me ghuskar ghadi aur cufflinks churane ke aarop me do logo par case darj hua; us samay ghar me koi shahi sadasya maujood nahi tha.

items.headline: Ukraine ko 45 arab euro karz ka samarthan
items.detail: EU shikhar sammelan me 24 sadasya deshon ne 2027 ke liye Ukraine ko 45 arab euro tak ke karz ke prastav ka samarthan kiya; antim faisla December me hoga.
items.exam_angle: EU aur Ukraine vittiya sahayata

items.headline: Britain ne 1 lakh reservist ko taiyar kiya
items.detail: Britain ke raksha mantralaya ne Sheet Yuddh ke baad pehli baar lagbhag 1 lakh poorv sainikon ko patra likhkar yuddh ki sthiti me wapas bulaye jaane ki taiyari karne ko kaha; ye kadam Russia ke badhte khatre ke beech uthaya gaya hai.
items.exam_angle: Britain, NATO, Russia khatra — UPSC IR

items.headline: Eisenkot ko sarkar ke liye dusra samjhota
items.detail: Israel me Gadi Eisenkot ki Yashar party ne vaam-panthi Democrats se gathbandhan samjhota kiya; do samjhauton ke baad bhi unke gut ke paas 120 me se sirf 36 seat hain, bahumat ke liye 61 chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Israel sarkar gathan, Knesset — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Huang koi suraksha khatra nahi
items.detail: America ke rashtrapati Trump ne kaha Nvidia ke CEO Jensen Huang koi suraksha khatra nahi hain; unhone khud Nvidia board se Huang ko CEO pad par wapas lane ko kaha tha.
items.exam_angle: America, AI chip, Nvidia — arthvyavastha

items.headline: America me toofan, 7 lakh ghar andhere me
items.detail: Thanksgiving par America ke purvi hisse me toofan se 9 lakh se zyada gharon ki bijli chali gayi aur lagbhag 400 udanein radd hui; New York ki Macy's parade 100 saal me pehli baar sthagit hokar shanivaar tak tali. (Updated: bijli ka aankda 9 lakh se zyada hua)

items.headline: Britain me net migration 29 saal me kam
items.detail: Britain ki net migration June 2026 tak ke saal me girkar 77,000 reh gayi, 1997 ke baad sabse kam; Bharatiya aane aur jaane dono me sabse bada samuh rahe.
items.exam_angle: Britain, migration, Bharatiya pravasi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Costa Rica ne UN rapporteur ko roka
items.detail: Costa Rica ne UN rapporteur Francesca Albanese ko desh me pravesh se roka; sarkar ne aatankwadi gatividhiyon se sambandh wali antarrashtriya alert ka hawala diya, jabki ve maanad degree lene aayi thi.
items.exam_angle: UN, Costa Rica, manavadhikar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Altria, Japan Tobacco Imperial kharidne ki taiyari me
items.detail: America ki Altria ne Britain ki Imperial Brands ke liye nagad khareed prastav par vichaar ki pushti ki; Japan Tobacco bhi sajhedari me hissa lene par vichaar kar raha hai, sauda lagbhag 34 arab dollar ka ho sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Videshi nivesh, vilay — arthvyavastha

items.headline: Australia ne Iran se jude 2 par pratibandh
items.detail: Australia ne Sydney aur Melbourne me 2024 ke yahudi-virodhi aagjani hamlo ke liye Iran ke IRGC ki or se kaam karne ke aarop me do vyaktiyon par aatankwadi vittaposhan pratibandh lagaye.
items.exam_angle: Australia, Iran, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: China ne Taiwan ke saamne landing abhyaas kiya
items.detail: China ne Fujian ke Dacheng Bay me nagrik jahazon ko jodkar lagbhag 800 meter lamba tairta pul banakar Taiwan par utarne ka abhyaas kiya; Taiwan ke raksha mantralaya ne kaha woh is gatividhi par nazar rakhe hue hai.
items.exam_angle: China-Taiwan, amphibious abhyaas — UPSC IR

items.headline: Drone Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa
items.detail: Shukravaar subah ek ajnaat drone thodi der ke liye Latvia ki hawai seema me ghusa; NATO ke ladaku viman aur interceptor drone bheje gaye, koi nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Latvia, NATO, drone ghuspaith — UPSC IR

items.headline: Duterte ka ICC mukadma Somvaar se
items.detail: Philippines ke poorv rashtrapati Rodrigo Duterte par ICC me manavta ke khilaf apraadh ka mukadma 30 November se shuru hoga; unpar 2011-2019 ke beech 85 hatyaon ke aarop hain.
items.exam_angle: ICC, Philippines, manavta ke khilaf apraadh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Erdogan ne Mecca raksha samjhota manzoor kiya
items.detail: Turkey ke rashtrapati Erdogan ne Pakistan aur Saudi Arabia ke saath Mecca sanyukt raksha samjhote ko aupcharik manzoori di; sansad ne ise 5 November ko pass kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: Turkey, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia raksha samjhota — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump: Putin G20 me aa sakte hain
items.detail: Trump ne kaha, Putin chahein to 14-15 December ko Miami me hone wale G20 sammelan me aa sakte hain; nimantran pehle se hai, Kremlin ne abhi faisla nahi liya.
items.exam_angle: G20, America-Russia, Putin — UPSC IR

items.headline: Kuwait me drone hamle me 2 Italian mare
items.detail: Kuwait ke ek hawai raksha kendra par drone hamle me Rheinmetall Italia ke 2 technician mare gaye; Italy aur Kuwait ne Iran par aarop lagaya, Iran ne inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Kuwait, Iran, drone hamla — UPSC IR

items.headline: Cuba ke paas jahaz dooba, 1 ki maut
items.detail: Panama jhande wala cargo jahaz Halima Cuba ke Artemisa tat ke paas doob gaya; 16 me se 13 mile, jinme ek ki maut hui, 3 abhi laapata hain.

items.headline: Houthi hamla: Saudi refinery me Nepali mara
items.detail: Saudi Arabia ki Jazan refinery par Houthi hamle me ek Nepali mazdoor mara gaya aur kai ghayal hue; aag lagi aur kuchh hissa band hua.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, Yemen yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Indonesia khadan baadh: 13 mare, 13 laapata
items.detail: Indonesia ke Bogor me gair-kanuni sone ki khadan me baadh se 13 mazdoor mare gaye aur 13 abhi 100 meter gehri khadan me fanse hain.
items.exam_angle: Indonesia, khanan durghatna — UPSC

items.headline: Russia ne Kyiv par missile hamla kiya
items.detail: Russia ne raat me Kyiv par ballistic missile se hamla kiya; ek shopping centre aur 2 imaratein nishana bani, 7 log ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: FIFA par cyber hamla, data chori hua
items.detail: FIFA ne kaha woh ek cyber hamle ka shikar hui, jisme vyaktigat aur vyavsayik jankari churai gayi; hamlaawaron ne staff bankar ghuspaith ki.
items.exam_angle: FIFA, cyber hamla — UPSC

items.headline: America me toofan: 9 lakh bina bijli
items.detail: Thanksgiving par aaye toofan se America ke purvi hisse me 9 lakh se zyada ghar bijli ke bina rahe; Macy's parade 100 saal me pehli baar tali aur 400 udanein radd hui.
items.exam_angle: America, nor'easter toofan — UPSC

items.headline: Cairo me tanker aag: 31 mare
items.detail: Cairo ki Ring Road par tel tanker palatne se lagi aag me 31 log mare aur 21 ghayal hue; 27 gaadiyan jal gayin aur zimmedar driver giraftar hua.
items.exam_angle: Egypt, Cairo — UPSC

items.headline: SpaceX ko 10 lakh satellite ki manzoori
items.detail: America ke FCC ne SpaceX ko antariksh me AI data centre ke liye 10 lakh satellite bhejne ki manzoori di; pehla satellite 2033 tak bhejna hoga.
items.exam_angle: SpaceX, FCC, AI — UPSC science-tech

items.headline: De Cos banenge ECB ke naye pramukh
items.detail: Eurozone ke netaon ne Spain ke Pablo Hernandez de Cos ko ECB ka agla pramukh chuna; woh February me Christine Lagarde ki jagah lenge.
items.exam_angle: ECB, Eurozone — UPSC economy

items.headline: Congo me Ebola: 12,000 case, 5,904 maut
items.detail: Congo me Ebola ke mamle 12,021 ho gaye aur 5,904 mautein hui; purvi hisse me ladai ke karan madad pahunchana mushkil ho raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Congo, Ebola — UPSC health

items.headline: Vietnam-America vyapar samjhota, tariff 35% se kam
items.detail: Vietnam ke PM Le Minh Hung ne kaha America se vyapar samjhota lagbhag tay ho gaya hai; America ka prastavit 35% tariff isse bahut kam hoga, aur dono desh hastakshar ki taiyari kar rahe hain.
items.exam_angle: Vietnam-America vyapar, Section 301 tariff — UPSC economy/IR

items.headline: Bangkok tel depot me dhamaka, 7 ghayal
items.detail: Bangkok ke Bangchak tel depot me dhamake aur aag se 7 log ghayal hue, jinme 4 ki haalat gambhir hai; refinery ki sabhi unit band kar di gayin aur aag par kabu pa liya gaya.

items.headline: China: Shanghai neta Chen Jining jaanch me
items.detail: China ke bhrashtachar-rodhi vibhag ne Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining ki jaanch shuru ki; woh 2022 ke baad jaanch me aaye chauthe Politburo sadasya hain.
items.exam_angle: China, CCP Politburo — UPSC IR

items.headline: Guinea-Bissau me chunav 2028 tak tale
items.detail: Sainya sarkar ne December me hone wale rashtrapati aur sansadiya chunav November 2028 tak taal diye; nagrik shasan ki vapasi me 2 saal ki deri hogi.
items.exam_angle: Guinea-Bissau, sainya takhtapalat, ECOWAS — UPSC IR

items.headline: Venezuela vipaksh par pratibandh wala kanoon hataega
items.detail: National Assembly 2024 ke Simon Bolivar kanoon ko radd karegi, jo pratibandhon ke samarthan par vipaksh ko saarvajanik pad se rokta tha.
items.exam_angle: Venezuela, antarim sarkar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Bharat-America sambandh ke sutradhar Talbott ka nidhan
items.detail: America ke poorv up-videsh mantri Strobe Talbott, 80, ka nidhan ho gaya; Pokhran-II ke baad Bharat-America baatchit me unki badi bhoomika thi.
items.exam_angle: Strobe Talbott, Bharat-America sambandh, Pokhran-II — UPSC IR

items.headline: Pakistan ke Zeeshan Ali Tiangong par pahunche
items.detail: China ke Shenzhou-24 mission me Pakistan ke Muhammad Zeeshan Ali Tiangong station par pahunche — pehle videshi astronaut.
items.exam_angle: Shenzhou-24, Tiangong, China-Pakistan — UPSC science-tech
items.image_credit: China News Service, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Riyadh tower par Houthi hamla, 11 ghayal
items.detail: Drone hamle me 2 Bharatiya samet 11 log ghayal hue; Bharat ne hamle ki ninda ki aur hamle turant rokne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Houthi, Saudi Arabia, Riyadh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Karachi me imarat giri, 7 mare
items.detail: Karachi ke Baloch Colony me chhah-manzila nirmanadheen imarat girne se 7 log mare aur 14 ghayal hue; malbe me fase logon ko nikaalne ka kaam jaari hai.

items.headline: Trump-Rutte baatchit: Ukraine, Iran, Greenland
items.detail: Mar-a-Lago me Trump aur NATO pramukh Mark Rutte ki baatchit me Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Iran ke parmanu karyakram aur Greenland samjhote par charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: NATO, Trump-Rutte, Ukraine yuddh — UPSC IR

items.headline: EU budget par samjhota nahi
items.detail: Brussels me 12 ghante se zyada baatchit ke baad EU neta 2028–2034 budget par sahmat nahi hue; Macron ne saal ke ant tak samjhote ki samay-seema rakhi, agla faisla 17–18 December ko hoga.
items.exam_angle: EU budget, MFF 2028–2034, Ukraine karz — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me tanker mine se phata
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ne kaha, shukravar subah Hormuz jaladmarumadhya me ek tel tanker mine se takrakar phat gaya, doosra tanker laut gaya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz sankat, tel vyapar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Myanmar ICJ faisla nahi manega
items.detail: Myanmar ke neta Min Aung Hlaing ne kaha, sarkar ICJ ke nar-sanhar faisle ke un hisson ko nahi manegi jinhe woh anuchit manti hai.
items.exam_angle: ICJ nar-sanhar faisla — UPSC IR

items.headline: China ke share bazaar me badi tezi
items.detail: Beijing ke bazaar ko sahara dene ke sanket ke baad China ke share bazaar me do saal ki sabse badi ek-din ki tezi aayi, Shanghai aur CSI300 lagbhag 4% chadhe.
items.exam_angle: China bazaar hastakshep — UPSC Economy
